text: 16.1 1 Did you see that thing in the paper about Shaney Wilson? No, what was that? Well, you remember she got married last September, right? Yeah, I think so. It's hard to keep up. Well, she's just got divorced. Apparently she found out that her husband was having an affair with another Hollywood actress. God, that didn't last long, did it? So did you get much of her money?
